en.name: Crispy Chicken Wings
en.why: High in protein, naturally low in carbohydrates, and made with just a few simple ingredients. Chicken wings are flavorful on their own, so you don't need a complicated sauce to make them delicious.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C), or the air fryer to 400°F (200°C).
Pat the chicken wings very dry with paper towel.
Toss the wings with olive oil, salt, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Place the wings on a baking sheet and bake for about 25–30 minutes.
en.notes:
Edible cooked meat and skin: Approximately 100–115 g
With bones included: Approximately 180–220 g cooked wings, depending on their size
Number of wings: Roughly 4–6 whole wings, or 8–12 wing sections (flats and drumettes)

zh.name: 脆皮鸡翅
zh.why: 高蛋白、低碳水，而且只需要几种简单食材。鸡翅本身味道丰富，不需要复杂的酱汁也很好吃。
steps: 将烤箱预热至 425°F（220°C），或将空气炸锅预热至 400°F（200°C）。
用纸巾将鸡翅彻底擦干。
将鸡翅与橄榄油、盐、蒜粉和黑胡椒拌匀。
将鸡翅放在烤盘上，尽量不要重叠。
烤约 25–30 分钟，中途翻面一次，直到鸡翅金黄酥脆并且完全熟透。
从烤箱取出后稍微放凉，即可享用。
zh.notes:
可以搭配简单的蔬菜，如黄瓜、沙拉或烤西兰花。
如果使用空气炸锅，可以分批烹饪，以确保鸡翅更加酥脆。
鸡翅本身含有较多脂肪，因此通常不需要额外添加很多油。

en.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
en.why: A probiotic, protein-rich start that keeps blood sugar steady.
ingredients: Mixed berries, 1 small bowl (fresh or frozen)
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and smooth the top.
Pile the berries on top; sprinkle with flaxseed and cinnamon.
Add a drizzle of honey only if a little sweetness is needed.
en.notes: 200g yogurt is about 3/4 cup

zh.name: 希腊酸奶莓果碗
zh.why: 益生菌 + 优质蛋白的开场，升糖平稳，适合作为一天的稳定起点。
ingredients: 混合莓果 1 小碗（新鲜或冷冻）
steps: 酸奶盛入碗中，用勺背抹平。
莓果铺在酸奶上，撒亚麻籽与肉桂粉。
如需甜味，淋极少量生蜂蜜即可。
zh.notes: 乳糖敏感者可换成椰子酸奶；想更低脂用 0% 希腊酸奶。

en.name: Beef & Veggie Chili
en.why: One pot makes five portions and improves with time — plenty of fibre and protein.
ingredients: Cumin, chilli powder, oregano, 1 tsp each
steps: Brown the beef in olive oil until slightly crusted.
Add the onion and pepper and soften, then stir in the spices.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer 30 minutes; season.
en.notes: Keeps 5 days chilled, 3 months frozen. Serve with avocado or yogurt.

zh.name: 牛肉蔬菜辣豆汤
zh.why: 一锅炖五天份，越放越入味，纤维与蛋白都很足。
ingredients: 洋葱、彩椒 各 1 个
孜然、辣椒粉、牛至 各 1 茶匙
steps: 橄榄油炒散牛肉末至微焦。
加洋葱彩椒炒软，下香料炒香。
加番茄与芸豆，小火炖 30 分钟调味。
zh.notes: 冷藏 5 天、冷冻 3 个月；可配牛油果或酸奶。

en.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon & Broccoli
en.why: One tray, almost no washing up — a low-carb, high-protein dinner template.
ingredients: Garlic powder, sea salt, black pepper
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the broccoli in oil and salt and spread on a tray.
Roast 8 minutes, then add the salmon and roast 12 minutes more.
Squeeze over lemon to finish.
en.notes: Roast an extra portion and take it for lunch the next day.

zh.name: 一盘烤三文鱼西兰花
zh.why: 一个烤盘搞定，几乎零清洗，低碳高蛋白的晚餐模板。
ingredients: 蒜粉、海盐、黑胡椒 适量
steps: 烤箱 200°C 预热；西兰花拌油盐铺盘。
先烤 8 分钟，放入三文鱼再烤 12 分钟。
出炉挤柠檬汁即可。
zh.notes: 一次多烤一份，第二天午餐直接带。

en.name: Thai Coconut Chicken Curry
en.why: Coconut milk is gentle on the gut and the curry spices are anti-inflammatory. Batch-friendly.
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken and brown, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk.
Add the vegetables and simmer 15 minutes; season with fish sauce and lime, then add basil.
en.notes: Serve with cauliflower rice for low carb. Keeps 4 days chilled.

zh.name: 泰式椰香咖喱鸡
zh.why: 椰奶温和不刺激，咖喱香料助抗炎，一锅可备餐。
ingredients: 彩椒、洋葱 各 1 个
steps: 咖喱酱用少量椰奶炒香。
加鸡肉块炒上色，倒入剩余椰奶。
加蔬菜炖 15 分钟，用鱼露与青柠调味，撒罗勒。
zh.notes: 配花菜饭为低碳版；冷藏 4 天。

en.name: Herb Roasted Chicken & Root Veg
en.why: Roast one tray at the weekend and you have protein all week; root veg brings slow carbs and fibre.
ingredients: Carrot, sweet potato, onion, as needed
steps: Toss the chopped vegetables and chicken in oil and herbs; spread on a tray.
Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until the skin is golden.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
en.notes: Swap sweet potato for cauliflower for a low-carb version.

zh.name: 香草烤鸡配根茎菜
zh.why: 周末烤一盘，全周有蛋白；根茎菜提供慢碳与纤维。
ingredients: 胡萝卜、红薯、洋葱 各适量
迷迭香、百里香 各 1 茶匙
steps: 蔬菜切块与鸡腿拌油与香草，铺烤盘。
200°C 烤 45 分钟至鸡皮金黄。
静置 5 分钟再上桌。
zh.notes: 红薯换成花菜即为低碳版。

en.name: Turkey Stuffed Bell Peppers
en.why: One pepper per portion — freeze them ahead and reheat on a busy day.
steps: Core the peppers. Sauté the onion and turkey, then add the tomatoes and spices.
Fill the peppers and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
en.notes: Add a little brown rice for extra satiety. Keeps 4 days chilled, 2 months frozen.

zh.name: 火鸡酿彩椒
zh.why: 一人份一个，预制好冷冻，忙碌日直接加热。
ingredients: 孜然、红椒粉 各 1 茶匙
steps: 彩椒去籽；炒香洋葱与火鸡肉末，加番茄与香料。
填入彩椒，200°C 烤 30 分钟。
出炉静置 5 分钟。
zh.notes: 可加少量糙米提升饱腹；冷藏 4 天、冷冻 2 个月。

en.name: Miso Glazed Cod with Greens
en.why: Cod is very low fat and high protein; the miso glaze adds colour and depth. A low-carb dinner staple.
steps: Mix the miso and mirin and coat the cod; rest 10 minutes.
Bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until the surface caramelises.
Stir-fry the pak choi with sesame oil, garlic and ginger; plate with the fish.
en.notes: Choose gluten-free miso if needed.

zh.name: 味噌烤鳕鱼配青菜
zh.why: 鳕鱼极低脂高蛋白，味噌上色提味，低碳晚餐首选。
ingredients: 白味噌 1 汤匙（选无麸质）
steps: 味噌与味醂调匀抹在鳕鱼上，腌 10 分钟。
200°C 烤 12 分钟至表面微焦。
上海青用麻油蒜姜快炒，与鱼同盘。
zh.notes: 无麸质者选无麸质味噌。

en.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken & Sweet Potato
en.why: A one-pan batch-cook dinner — protein, slow carbs and fibre for the whole week.
steps: Toss everything in oil and spices on a tray.
Roast at 220°C for 25–30 minutes until the chicken is golden and the potatoes are tender.
en.notes: Make double — portion into containers for 4 lunches.

zh.name: 一盘烤鸡红薯
zh.why: 一锅备餐晚餐，蛋白 + 慢碳 + 纤维，一周备齐。
ingredients: 烟熏红椒粉、蒜粉、迷迭香 适量
steps: 所有食材拌油与香料铺烤盘。
220°C 烤 25–30 分钟至鸡腿金黄、红薯软糯。
zh.notes: 做双份，分装 4 份午餐。

en.name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
en.why: Effortless batch protein — perfect for tacos, bowls or lettuce wraps all week.
ingredients: Smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder 1 tbsp each
steps: Rub the pork with spices; place in the slow cooker with vinegar.
Cook on low 8 hours until it shreds easily.
Shred with two forks; stir in BBQ sauce.
en.notes: Freezes 3 months. Serve with cauliflower rice or in lettuce wraps.

zh.name: 慢炖手撕猪肉
zh.why: 零费力批量蛋白，一周做塔可、碗餐或生菜包都行。
ingredients: 烟熏红椒粉、孜然、蒜粉 各 1 汤匙
steps: 猪肉抹香料，放入慢炖锅加醋。
低温炖 8 小时至轻松撕散。
用两把叉子撕碎，拌入烧烤酱。
zh.notes: 可冷冻 3 个月；配花菜饭或生菜包吃。

en.name: Lemon Herb Cod
en.why: A 20-minute low-fat, high-protein dinner — bright with lemon, fresh with herbs.
ingredients: Green beans or asparagus to serve
steps: Pat the cod dry; season. Heat oil and garlic in a pan.
Sear the cod 3 minutes per side until flaky.
Finish with lemon juice and herbs; serve with greens.
en.notes: Use haddock or any white fish. Avoid overcooking.

zh.name: 柠檬香草鳕鱼
zh.why: 20 分钟低脂高蛋白晚餐，柠檬清新、香草提味。
ingredients: 四季豆或芦笋 适量
steps: 鳕鱼擦干调味；锅里热油加蒜。
下鳕鱼每面煎 3 分钟至酥。
淋柠檬汁撒香草，配青菜。
zh.notes: 可用黑线鳕或任何白肉鱼；别过熟。

en.name: Shrimp & Veggie Stir-Fry
en.why: Shrimp cooks in minutes and is very high in protein — a quick weeknight dinner.
steps: Heat sesame oil; sauté the garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and stir-fry until pink; remove and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables until tender; return the shrimp and add tamari.
en.notes: Add a splash of rice vinegar at the end for brightness.

zh.name: 虾仁蔬菜炒
zh.why: 虾仁几分钟熟且高蛋白，工作日晚餐快手。
steps: 芝麻油热锅，炒香蒜姜。
下虾仁炒至变粉，盛出。
炒蔬菜至软，回锅虾仁加生抽。
zh.notes: 起锅前淋少许米醋更鲜亮。

en.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs & Sea Salt
en.why: The simplest low-carb, high-protein snack. Boil a dozen and keep them in the fridge.
steps: Start in cold water; once boiling, cook 7 minutes (soft) or 10 (firm).
Cool in iced water, peel, and season with salt.
en.notes: Keeps a week chilled — a zero-cost batch-cook option.

zh.name: 海盐溏心蛋
zh.why: 最省事的低碳高蛋白零食，一次煮一打放冰箱随取。
steps: 冷水下蛋，水开后煮 7 分钟（溏心）或 10 分钟（全熟）。
冰水冷却后剥壳，撒盐即可。
zh.notes: 冷藏可存 1 周，是 batch-cook 的零成本选项。

en.name: Veggie Sticks & Guacamole
en.why: Low-carb, no-cook and high in fibre — veggie sticks replace crisps for that crunch.
ingredients: Cucumber, carrot, bell pepper, as needed
steps: Mash the avocado with lime, onion, coriander and salt.
Cut the vegetables into sticks and dip.
en.notes: Press cling film onto the guacamole to stop it browning.

zh.name: 蔬菜条配牛油果酱
zh.why: 低碳、免烹、纤维足，用蔬菜条代替薯片满足咀嚼欲。
ingredients: 黄瓜、胡萝卜、彩椒 各适量
steps: 牛油果压泥，拌青柠汁、洋葱、香菜与盐。
蔬菜切条，蘸食即可。
zh.notes: 牛油果酱表面盖保鲜膜贴面冷藏，防氧化变黑。

en.name: Greek Yogurt with Honey & Walnuts
en.why: Probiotics plus omega-3s, with sweetness from honey — far better than a dessert.
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl; add the walnuts and cinnamon and drizzle with honey.
en.notes: Watching sugar closely? Use extra cinnamon instead of honey.

zh.name: 希腊酸奶蜂蜜核桃
zh.why: 益生菌 + Omega-3，甜味来自蜂蜜，比甜点健康得多。
steps: 酸奶入碗，撒核桃与肉桂，淋蜂蜜。
zh.notes: 控糖严格者可用肉桂代替蜂蜜。

en.name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
en.why: Crunchy enough to replace crisps, with good fibre and plant protein.
steps: Dry the chickpeas thoroughly and toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 200°C for 30 minutes, shaking halfway.
They crisp up further as they cool.
en.notes: Keeps a week in an airtight jar. The drier they are, the crunchier they get.

zh.name: 香烤鹰嘴豆
zh.why: 烤脆后当零食，纤维与植物蛋白高，替代薯片。
ingredients: 鹰嘴豆 1 540mL 罐（沥干擦干）
孜然、红椒粉、海盐 各适量
steps: 鹰嘴豆彻底擦干，拌油与香料。
200°C 烤 30 分钟，中途摇匀。
出炉后放凉会更脆。
zh.notes: 密封罐存 1 周；擦得越干越脆。

en.name: Trail Mix
en.why: A balanced handful of nuts, seeds and a touch of dark chocolate.
steps: Mix together; portion into small jars.
en.notes: Keep portions small — nuts are calorie-dense. Make a week of jars at once.

zh.name: 综合果仁能量混合
zh.why: 一份均衡的坚果 + 种子 + 少量黑巧。
ingredients: 黑巧克力碎 1 茶匙（70% 以上）
steps: 混合均匀，分装小瓶。
zh.notes: 分量别大——坚果热量高。一次做一周的。

en.name: Smoked Salmon Avocado Toast
en.why: Omega-3s, healthy fats and protein — satisfying for a busy morning.
ingredients: Lemon juice, sea salt, black pepper
steps: Toast the bread until crisp; mash the avocado on top.
Layer on the salmon, squeeze over lemon, season with salt and pepper.
en.notes: Gluten-free? Use gluten-free bread. Vegetarian? Try smoked tofu instead.

zh.name: 烟熏三文鱼牛油果吐司
zh.why: Omega-3 + 好脂肪 + 蛋白，饱腹感强，适合忙碌早晨。
ingredients: 柠檬汁、海盐、黑胡椒 适量
steps: 面包烤至微脆，牛油果压成泥抹上。
铺三文鱼，挤柠檬汁，撒盐与黑胡椒。
zh.notes: 需要无麸质者换无麸质面包；素食者可用烟熏豆腐替代。

en.name: Steamed Egg Custard
en.why: Silky and very easy to digest — high protein, low carb. Good for a weak appetite or recovery.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the warm water and strain to remove foam.
Cover with cling film, prick a hole, and steam over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Drizzle with tamari and sesame oil; scatter over scallions.
en.notes: Keep the heat moderate or the custard will become honeycombed.

zh.name: 中式蒸水蛋
zh.why: 极嫩易消化，高蛋白低碳，适合胃口弱或术后恢复期。
steps: 蛋液加温水搅匀，过筛去泡。
盖保鲜膜戳孔，水开后中火蒸 10 分钟。
淋生抽与香油，撒葱花。
zh.notes: 蒸时火力别太大，否则会起蜂窝。

en.name: Coconut Berry Smoothie
en.why: A no-cook plant-based smoothie — electrolytes from coconut and antioxidants from berries.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
en.notes: Use full-fat coconut milk from a tin for a creamier, higher-calorie version.

zh.name: 椰香莓果思慕雪
zh.why: 免烹植物奶昔，椰子补电解质，莓果补抗氧化。
steps: 所有材料打至顺滑。
倒入杯中即刻饮用。
zh.notes: 用罐装全脂椰奶更浓郁、热量更高。

en.name: Veggie Frittata
en.why: A slice-and-go breakfast that keeps three days — packed with vegetables and protein.
steps: Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan; wilt the spinach and soften the tomatoes.
Pour beaten seasoned eggs over the vegetables; scatter feta on top.
Cook on low 8 minutes, then finish under the grill until golden.
en.notes: Eat cold or warm — slice into quarters and store in the fridge.

zh.name: 蔬菜烘蛋
zh.why: 切件即走，可存三天，蔬菜与蛋白满满。
steps: 烤箱适用锅中热橄榄油，炒软菠菜与小番茄。
倒入调味蛋液，撒羊奶酪。
小火 8 分钟，再放上层烤至金黄。
zh.notes: 冷热皆宜——切四块冷藏保存。

en.name: Matcha Chia Pudding
en.why: Matcha adds antioxidants; chia brings soluble fibre for a gentle, no-cook breakfast.
steps: Whisk matcha into the almond milk until smooth.
Stir in the chia and maple syrup; rest 10 minutes and stir again.
Chill at least 4 hours; top with coconut flakes.
en.notes: Double or triple the recipe for a week of breakfasts.

zh.name: 抹茶奇亚籽布丁
zh.why: 抹茶增抗氧化物，奇亚籽补可溶性纤维，免烹温和早餐。
steps: 抹茶粉加入杏仁奶搅匀至无颗粒。
拌入奇亚籽与枫糖，静置 10 分钟后再搅一次。
冷藏至少 4 小时，撒椰蓉。
zh.notes: 可翻倍或三倍量做一周早餐。

en.name: Sugar-Free Beef Jerky
en.why: Pure protein, low carb — the most convenient option when out and about.
steps: Eat as is; a glass of water makes it more filling.
en.notes: Read the label — many jerkies contain sugar or soy sauce (gluten).

zh.name: 无糖牛肉干
zh.why: 纯蛋白低碳零食，出门/开车时最方便的选择。
ingredients: 无糖牛肉干 30g（选无亚硝酸盐、无麸质款）
steps: 直接食用；配一杯水更饱。
zh.notes: 注意看配料表，很多牛肉干含糖或酱油（麸质）。

en.name: Tomato Egg Stir-Fry
en.why: A beloved home-style dish: juicy tomatoes folded into soft scrambled eggs.
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt; soft-scramble and set aside.
Add tomatoes to the pan with sugar; cook until saucy.
Fold eggs back in; top with spring onion.
en.notes: A splash of ketchup deepens the colour and tang.

zh.name: 番茄炒蛋
zh.why: 家常菜：多汁番茄裹软炒蛋。
steps: 蛋加盐打匀，嫩炒盛出。
番茄入锅加糖炒至出汁。
倒回蛋花，撒葱花。
zh.notes: 少许番茄酱增色增酸。

en.name: Steamed Fish with Ginger and Spring Onion
en.why: Gentle steaming keeps fish tender and digestible — a gut-friendly protein.
steps: Lay fish on a plate; scatter half the ginger.
Steam 8–10 min until just opaque.
Top with spring onion and remaining ginger.
Heat oil until smoking; pour over to sizzle. Add soy.
en.notes: Any firm white fish — cod, tilapia, barramundi — works.

zh.name: 清蒸鱼（葱姜）
zh.why: 清蒸保嫩易消化，养胃高蛋白。
ingredients: 生抽 2 汤匙、油 2 汤匙
steps: 鱼置盘，撒一半姜丝。
蒸 8–10 分钟至刚透。
放葱丝与余下姜。
热油浇淋激香，淋生抽。
zh.notes: 鳕鱼、罗非、盲槽皆可。

en.name: Steak with Asparagus
en.why: A simple iron- and protein-rich dinner with tender green veg.
steps: Season steak with salt; sear in a hot pan 3 min per side for medium-rare.
Rest the steak.
In the same pan, wilt garlic and asparagus in butter 3 min.
Slice steak; serve with asparagus.
en.notes: Rest the meat before slicing to keep it juicy.

zh.name: 牛排配芦笋
zh.why: 高蛋白高铁，配嫩芦笋。
ingredients: 牛排 2 块（西冷或牛腩排 300g）
steps: 牛排抹盐，热锅每面 3 分钟至三五分熟。
静置。
原锅黄油蒜芦笋炒 3 分钟。
牛排切片配芦笋。
zh.notes: 切前静置保汁。

en.name: Steamed Ribs in Black Bean Sauce
en.why: Cantonese steamed spare ribs with fermented black beans — tender and savoury.
steps: Marinate ribs with mashed black beans, garlic, ginger, soy, sugar and starch 20 min.
Spread ribs in a shallow dish; steam over high heat 25 min.
Scatter spring onion; serve hot with rice.
en.notes: Ask the butcher to chop the ribs small for steaming.

zh.name: 豆豉蒸排骨
zh.why: 粤式小排配豆豉，软嫩咸香。
steps: 排骨加压碎豆豉、蒜姜、生抽、糖、淀粉腌 20 分钟。
铺平盘大火蒸 25 分钟。
撒葱花，配饭。
zh.notes: 请肉贩把小排斩小件。

en.name: Savory Tofu Pudding (Dou Hua)
en.why: Silky warm tofu pudding with a savoury soy-sesame sauce.
ingredients: Pickled radish, chilli oil, spring onion to top
steps: Gently heat tofu in hot water 2 min; drain and scoop into bowls.
Combine soy and sesame oil; pour over.
Top with pickled radish, spring onion and chilli oil.
en.notes: The softest tofu you can find gives the best texture.

zh.name: 咸豆花
zh.why: 嫩滑热豆花配咸香酱汁。
ingredients: 萝卜干、辣椒油、葱花 点缀
steps: 豆腐热水温 2 分钟，沥干舀入碗。
生抽香油混合浇上。
撒萝卜干、葱花、辣椒油。
zh.notes: 越嫩的豆腐口感越好。

en.name: Pork Liver Stir-Fry with Chives
en.why: Iron- and vitamin-A rich liver, quick-cooked to stay tender.
steps: Soak liver in water 10 min; drain and toss with soy, wine and starch.
Blanch liver 30 sec, drain.
Stir-fry ginger and garlic, add liver, then chives; season and serve.
en.notes: Quick cooking keeps liver tender; overcooking makes it grainy.

zh.name: 韭菜炒猪肝
zh.why: 高铁高维A，快炒保嫩。
steps: 猪肝水泡 10 分钟，沥干加生抽、料酒、淀粉。
焯水 30 秒沥干。
姜蒜爆炒，下肝再下韭菜，调味即可。
zh.notes: 快炒保嫩，过熟会起沙。

en.name: Braised Pork Feet
en.why: Collagen-rich, slow-braised until meltingly tender.
ingredients: Soy sauce 1/3 cup, dark soy 2 tbsp
steps: Blanch pork feet 5 min; rinse.
Simmer with all seasonings and water 1.5–2 hr until tender.
Reduce sauce to glossy; serve hot.
en.notes: Make ahead — flavour improves overnight; skim fat before reheating.

zh.name: 红烧猪脚
zh.why: 富含胶原蛋白，慢炖至软糯。
ingredients: 生抽 1/3 杯、老抽 2 汤匙
steps: 猪脚焯水 5 分钟洗净。
加所有调料与水小火 1.5–2 小时至软糯。
收汁挂亮，趁热食。
zh.notes: 提前做好味更浓；复热前撇油。

en.name: Teriyaki Glazed Salmon
en.why: Omega-3-rich salmon with a glossy sweet-savoury glaze.
ingredients: Soy 2 tbsp, mirin 2 tbsp, sugar 1 tsp
steps: Sear salmon skin-down 4-5 min; flip and cook 2-3 min.
Add soy, mirin, sugar and ginger; spoon glaze over until thick, about 2-5 minutes.
Top with sesame and spring onion.
en.notes: Serve with steamed rice or greens.

zh.name: 照烧三文鱼
zh.why: 富含Omega-3，甜咸挂汁。
ingredients: 生抽 2 汤匙、味淋 2 汤匙、糖 1 茶匙
steps: 鱼皮朝下煎 4-5 分钟，翻面 2-3 分钟。
加生抽、味淋、糖、姜，淋汁挂稠。
撒芝麻葱花。
zh.notes: 配米饭或青菜。

en.name: Soy-Braised Chicken Drumsticks
en.why: Fall-apart drumsticks in a deeply savoury soy rock-sugar glaze.
ingredients: Rock sugar 1 tbsp, cooking wine 2 tbsp
steps: Brown drumsticks in oil.
Add ginger, star anise, soy, wine, sugar and water to nearly cover.
Simmer 30 min, turning once, until tender.
Reduce sauce to coat.
en.notes: Make a day ahead; the flavour deepens overnight.

zh.name: 红烧鸡腿
zh.why: 脱骨鸡腿，酱香浓挂。
ingredients: 生抽 3 汤匙、老抽 1 汤匙
冰糖 1 汤匙、料酒 2 汤匙
steps: 鸡腿煎至上色。
加姜、八角、生抽、酒、糖、水近没。
小火 30 分钟翻一次至软。
收汁挂匀。
zh.notes: 提前一天更入味。

en.name: Braised Beef Shank
en.why: Slow-braised shank turns meltingly tender; the gelatin is gut-friendly.
ingredients: Rock sugar, star anise, cinnamon, ginger
steps: Blanch shank 5 min; rinse.
Simmer with all seasonings and water 2–2.5 hr until a skewer slides in easily.
Cool in the liquid, then slice thinly.
Reduce braising liquid to a dipping sauce.
en.notes: Chilled slices make a great cold plate; broth keeps for soups.

zh.name: 卤牛腱
zh.why: 慢卤至软糯，胶质养胃。
ingredients: 生抽 1/3 杯、老抽 2 汤匙
steps: 牛腱焯水 5 分钟洗净。
加所有调料与水小火 2–2.5 小时至筷子穿透。
卤汁中晾凉切薄片。
卤汁收浓作蘸料。
zh.notes: 冷片作冷盘；卤汁留作汤底。

en.name: Pork Rib and Lotus Root Soup
en.why: A clear, nourishing slow soup; lotus root is crunchy and soothing.
steps: Blanch ribs 3 min; rinse.
Simmer ribs, lotus root, ginger and water 1 hour.
Add goji; simmer 15 min; salt to taste.
en.notes: A clay pot gives the clearest, sweetest soup.

zh.name: 排骨莲藕汤
zh.why: 清润慢汤，莲藕粉脆养胃。
steps: 排骨焯水 3 分钟洗净。
排骨、莲藕、姜、水小火 1 小时。
加枸杞 15 分钟，盐调味。
zh.notes: 砂锅煲最清甜。

en.name: Mashed Potato
en.why: A soft, easily digested side; gentle on the stomach.
steps: Boil peeled potatoes 15 min until tender; drain.
Mash with butter, milk, salt and pepper until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
en.notes: For a lighter version, swap butter/milk for stock.

zh.name: 土豆泥
zh.why: 软糯易消化的配菜，养胃。
steps: 去皮土豆煮 15 分钟至软，沥干。
加黄油、奶、盐胡椒压成泥。
调咸淡。
zh.notes: 清淡版可用高汤代奶。

en.name: Roasted Sweet Potato
en.why: Naturally sweet, fibre-rich, and gentle on digestion.
steps: Heat oven to 200°C.
Rub potatoes with oil and salt.
Roast 35–40 min until a knife slides through.
en.notes: Top with butter and cinnamon for a sweeter side.

zh.name: 烤红薯
zh.why: 自然甜、纤维高，养胃。
steps: 红薯抹油盐。
烤 35–40 分钟至刀透。
zh.notes: 抹黄油肉桂更甜。

en.name: Seaweed Egg Drop Soup
en.why: A mineral-rich, light soup with silky egg and nori.
steps: Bring stock to a boil; add seaweed.
Drizzle beaten egg in a thin stream to form ribbons.
Season with soy, sesame oil and pepper.
en.notes: A 5-minute soup when you need something warm and gentle.

zh.name: 紫菜蛋花汤
zh.why: 矿物质丰富，紫菜蛋花清淡。
ingredients: 生抽 1 汤匙、香油 1 茶匙
steps: 汤烧开下紫菜。
蛋液细流淋入成蛋花。
生抽香油胡椒调味。
zh.notes: 5 分钟暖汤。

en.name: Mushroom Tofu Soup
en.why: A savoury, umami soup with soft tofu and mushrooms.
steps: Simmer mushrooms in stock 8 min.
Add cubed tofu; simmer 5 min.
Season with soy and sesame oil; top with spring onion.
en.notes: Shiitake, oyster and enoki make a good mix.

zh.name: 菌菇豆腐汤
zh.why: 鲜味汤，豆腐菌菇软嫩。
ingredients: 生抽 1 汤匙、香油 1 茶匙
steps: 菌菇入汤煮 8 分钟。
加豆腐丁煮 5 分钟。
生抽香油调味，撒葱花。
zh.notes: 香菇、杏鲍菇、金针菇混搭。

en.name: Turkey Taco Skillet
en.why: A 15-minute one-pan dinner — Mexican flavour without the wrap carbs.
steps: Sauté onion and pepper; add turkey and brown.
Stir in seasoning and tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve in bowls topped with avocado, lime and cilantro.
en.notes: Add cauliflower rice for more bulk without carbs.

zh.name: 火鸡塔可锅
zh.why: 15 分钟一锅晚餐，墨西哥风味，不包饼皮少碳水。
steps: 炒香洋葱彩椒，加火鸡肉末炒散。
加调味与番茄，炖 5 分钟。
装碗铺牛油果、青柠与香菜。
zh.notes: 加花菜米更饱腹不升碳。

en.name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
en.why: A plant-based Asian dinner — tofu adds protein, vegetables add fibre.
steps: Press and cube the tofu; pan-fry until golden.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger, then vegetables; return the tofu.
Add tamari and sesame oil; toss to finish.
en.notes: Press tofu 15 min for best texture. Add chilli if you like heat.

zh.name: 豆腐蔬菜炒
zh.why: 亚洲植物晚餐，豆腐补蛋白，蔬菜补纤维。
ingredients: 蒜末、姜末 各 1 茶匙
steps: 豆腐压水切丁，煎至金黄。
炒香蒜姜，下蔬菜快炒，回锅豆腐。
加生抽与芝麻油翻匀出锅。
zh.notes: 豆腐压 15 分钟口感更好；喜辣可加辣椒。

en.name: Tuna Avocado Salad
en.why: No-cook and done in five minutes — healthy fats and protein to avoid an afternoon slump.
steps: Drain the tuna and toss with the avocado and celery.
Dress with lemon and olive oil; season to taste.
en.notes: Serve in lettuce leaves or cucumber cups to keep it lower carb.

zh.name: 金枪鱼牛油果沙拉
zh.why: 免烹、5 分钟搞定，好脂肪 + 蛋白，下午不犯困。
steps: 金枪鱼沥干，与牛油果块、芹菜拌匀。
淋柠檬汁与橄榄油，调味即可。
zh.notes: 配生菜叶或黄瓜片当"船"吃，更低碳。

en.name: Rotisserie Chicken with Bagged Salad
en.why: The fastest real-food meal: hot chicken, crisp bagged greens.
steps: Carve the chicken into pieces.
Toss salad with dressing.
Plate chicken alongside the salad.
en.notes: Strip leftover meat for tomorrow's lunches or broth.

zh.name: 烤鸡配袋装沙拉
zh.why: 最快正餐：热烤鸡配袋装沙拉。
steps: 烤鸡切块。
沙拉拌酱。
同盘上桌。
zh.notes: 剩肉可做次日午餐或熬汤。

en.name: Cold Shredded Chicken
en.why: A no-cook way to turn leftover chicken into a fragrant cold dish.
steps: Shred leftover chicken by hand.
Toss with soy, sesame oil and spring onion.
Add chilli oil if desired; serve at room temperature.
en.notes: Perfect use for rotisserie or poached chicken.

zh.name: 凉拌鸡丝
zh.why: 剩鸡肉变香喷凉菜，免煮。
steps: 剩鸡手撕成丝。
拌入生抽、香油、葱花。
可加辣椒油，常温食。
zh.notes: 烤鸡或白煮鸡都适用。

en.name: Tofu with Century Egg
en.why: A cool, silky cold dish — cold tofu, century egg, soy and sesame.
ingredients: Soy sauce 2 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tsp
steps: Drain tofu, slice and plate.
Arrange century egg pieces on top.
Drizzle soy and sesame oil; scatter onion and sesame.
en.notes: Best chilled; add chilli oil if you like heat.

zh.name: 皮蛋豆腐
zh.why: 凉菜：凉豆腐配皮蛋，香油生抽。
ingredients: 生抽 2 汤匙、香油 1 茶匙
steps: 豆腐沥干切片码盘。
皮蛋瓣摆上。
淋生抽香油，撒葱花芝麻。
zh.notes: 冰过更好吃，喜辣可加辣椒油。

en.name: Chinese Chive and Egg
en.why: A quick scramble of garlic chives and egg — soft, fragrant, simple.
ingredients: Garlic chives 150g, cut into 2 cm pieces
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat oil, briefly wilt chives.
Pour in eggs, fold gently until just set.
en.notes: Don't overcook — the eggs should stay soft and the chives bright green.

zh.name: 韭菜炒蛋
zh.why: 韭菜与蛋快炒，软嫩清香。
steps: 蛋加盐胡椒打匀。
热油快炒韭菜至软。
倒蛋液轻拌至刚凝固。
zh.notes: 勿过熟，蛋要嫩、韭菜翠绿。

en.name: Twice-Cooked Pork
en.why: Sichuan classic: boiled then stir-fried pork belly with leeks and doubanjiang.
ingredients: Doubanjiang 1 tbsp, sweet bean sauce 1 tbsp
steps: Simmer pork belly 20 min in water with ginger; cool and slice thin.
Stir-fry slices until edges curl.
Add doubanjiang, sweet bean sauce, garlic.
Toss in sliced leek; cook until just wilted.
en.notes: The boil-then-fry method renders fat for a crisp, less greasy result.

zh.name: 回锅肉
zh.why: 川味：五花肉先煮后炒，配蒜苗豆瓣酱。
ingredients: 豆瓣酱 1 汤匙、甜面酱 1 汤匙
steps: 五花肉加姜片煮 20 分钟，晾凉切薄片。
煸至肉片卷曲出油。
加豆瓣酱、甜面酱、蒜。
下蒜苗段炒至断生。
zh.notes: 先煮后炒出油，更香不腻。

en.name: Hummus with Vegetables
en.why: Plant protein and fibre from chickpeas, with crisp raw veg.
ingredients: Olive oil and paprika to finish
steps: Arrange vegetables around a bowl of hummus.
Drizzle olive oil and dust with paprika.
en.notes: Use store-bought hummus or blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic.

zh.name: 鹰嘴豆泥配蔬菜
zh.why: 鹰嘴豆提供植物蛋白与纤维，配生蔬。
ingredients: 胡萝卜、黄瓜、彩椒 条
橄榄油、辣椒粉 收尾
steps: 蔬菜围着豆泥摆盘。
淋橄榄油撒辣椒粉。
zh.notes: 可买现成或自制（鹰嘴豆、芝麻酱、柠檬、蒜）。

en.name: Beef Meatballs with Marinara
en.why: Tender beef meatballs simmered in a simple tomato sauce.
steps: Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper; roll into balls.
Brown meatballs in a pan.
Pour in marinara, simmer 15 min.
Finish with basil; serve with pasta or zoodles.
en.notes: Meatballs keep 4 days in the fridge.

zh.name: 牛肉丸配番茄酱
zh.why: 嫩牛肉丸在简易番茄酱中慢炖。
ingredients: 鸡蛋 1 个、面包糠 1/4 杯
steps: 牛肉、蛋、面包糠、蒜、盐胡椒拌匀搓丸。
平底锅煎至微黄。
加番茄酱小火 15 分钟。
撒罗勒，配意面或西葫芦面。
zh.notes: 肉丸冷藏 4 天没问题。

en.name: Vietnamese Pork Meatballs
en.why: Juicy, lightly sweet pork meatballs with fish sauce and herbs.
steps: Mix pork with fish sauce, sugar, garlic, pepper and minced lemongrass.
Roll into 24 balls.
Pan-fry until golden and cooked through.
Serve over rice or in lettuce wraps with herbs.
en.notes: These freeze well; double the batch.

zh.name: 越式猪肉丸
zh.why: 多汁微甜的鱼露猪肉丸，配香草。
ingredients: 鱼露 1 汤匙、糖 1 茶匙
steps: 肉末加鱼露、糖、蒜、胡椒、香茅末拌匀。
搓 24 个丸。
平底锅煎至金黄熟透。
配饭或生菜包吃。
zh.notes: 可冷冻，建议加倍做。

en.name: Bibimbap Bowl
en.why: Korean rice bowl topped with seasoned vegetables, egg and a spicy-sweet sauce.
ingredients: Spinach, carrot, bean sprouts 1 cup each
Gochujang 1 tbsp, soy, sesame oil, sugar
steps: Season each vegetable separately with salt and sesame oil; sauté briefly.
Brown beef with soy and sugar.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Arrange rice, veg, beef and egg in bowls; top with gochujang and sesame oil.
en.notes: Mix everything together just before eating.

zh.name: 韩式拌饭
zh.why: 韩式饭碗：调味蔬菜、肉、蛋配辣甜酱。
ingredients: 菠菜、胡萝卜、豆芽各 1 杯
辣酱 1 汤匙、生抽、香油、糖
steps: 各蔬菜分别加盐香油快炒。
肉末加生抽糖煸熟。
煎单面蛋。
碗中码饭、菜、肉、蛋，淋辣酱香油。
zh.notes: 吃前拌匀。

en.name: Burrito Bowl
en.why: All the flavour of a burrito, layered in a bowl — no wrap needed.
steps: Brown the meat with a little cumin and salt.
Layer rice, beans, meat and salsa in bowls.
Top with cheese, avocado and a squeeze of lime.
en.notes: Make it vegetarian with extra beans instead of meat.

zh.name: 墨西哥卷饭碗
zh.why: 卷饼风味层层叠入碗中，无需饼皮。
ingredients: 奶酪、牛油果、青柠 点缀
steps: 肉末加孜然与盐煸熟。
碗中分层放饭、豆、肉、莎莎酱。
撒奶酪、牛油果，挤青柠。
zh.notes: 素食可多放豆类代替肉。

en.name: Shabu Shabu Bowl
en.why: Hotpot-style bowl: broth cooks thin beef and greens in minutes.
ingredients: Soy sauce & sesame oil to taste
steps: Bring broth to a rolling boil in a small pot.
Add glass noodles and greens, cook 1 min.
Swirl in beef rolls; they cook in seconds.
Season with soy and sesame oil; serve hot.
en.notes: Any quick-cooking greens — bok choy, spinach, chrysanthemum greens — work.

zh.name: 寿喜锅风牛肉碗
zh.why: 火锅风：滚汤秒烫肥牛与青菜。
steps: 小锅高汤烧开。
下粉丝与青菜煮 1 分钟。
拨入肥牛卷，数秒即熟。
调味生抽香油，趁热吃。
zh.notes: 任何快熟青菜均可——小白菜、菠菜、茼蒿。

en.name: Mapo Tofu with Ground Pork
en.why: Sichuan comfort: soft tofu in a spicy, savoury pork sauce.
ingredients: Soy sauce 1 tbsp, garlic & ginger minced
Spring onion, sesame oil to finish
steps: Brown pork with ginger and garlic.
Add doubanjiang, fry until oil reddens.
Add tofu, soy and 1/2 cup water; simmer 5 min.
Thicken lightly, dust with Sichuan pepper, add sesame oil and onion.
en.notes: For a vegetarian version, swap pork for mushrooms.

zh.name: 麻婆豆腐（猪肉末）
zh.why: 川味家常，豆腐嫩滑、肉末香辣。
ingredients: 生抽 1 汤匙，蒜末姜末
steps: 肉末与姜蒜煸至变色。
加豆瓣酱炒出红油。
放豆腐、生抽与半杯水煮 5 分钟。
微收汁，撒花椒粉，淋香油葱花。
zh.notes: 素食可用菌菇代替肉末。

en.name: Grilled Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
en.why: The classic meal-prep bowl: protein, complex carbs and vegetables — three portions at once.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon, garlic powder, sea salt
steps: Cook the quinoa in 1:2 water for 15 minutes.
Season and pan-sear or bake the chicken; rest and slice.
Blanch the broccoli and divide everything into three bowls.
en.notes: Keeps 4 days chilled; dress with lemon and olive oil before eating.

zh.name: 烤鸡藜麦碗
zh.why: 经典备餐碗，蛋白 + 复合碳水 + 蔬菜，一次做三份。
ingredients: 橄榄油、柠檬、蒜粉、海盐 适量
steps: 藜麦按 1:2 水煮 15 分钟。
鸡胸调味后煎/烤至熟，静置切片。
西兰花焯水，与藜麦、鸡胸、小番茄分装成碗。
zh.notes: 冷藏 4 天；吃前淋柠檬橄榄油汁。

en.name: Lentil & Roasted Veg Soup
en.why: Plant protein plus plenty of soluble fibre — a gentle workhorse for a gut-healing phase.
steps: Sweat the onion, carrot and celery in olive oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and spices; simmer 25 minutes.
Mash lightly with a spoon for a thicker texture and season.
en.notes: Keeps 5 days chilled, 3 months frozen — very low effort.

zh.name: 扁豆烤蔬菜浓汤
zh.why: 植物蛋白 + 大量可溶性纤维，是肠道修复期的温和主力。
ingredients: 胡萝卜、西芹、洋葱 各适量
孜然、姜黄 各 1/2 茶匙
steps: 橄榄油炒香洋葱、胡萝卜、西芹。
加扁豆、番茄、高汤与香料，煮开后小火 25 分钟。
用勺背略压出浓稠感，调味即可。
zh.notes: 冷藏 5 天、冷冻 3 个月，非常省事。

en.name: Miso Salmon Rice Bowl
en.why: Fermented miso supports the gut and salmon adds omega-3s — a balanced single bowl.
steps: Mix the miso and mirin into a glaze; coat the salmon and rest 10 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake the salmon until cooked through.
Bowl up the rice, add the salmon, edamame and cucumber, and finish with nori.
en.notes: Check the miso label — most contain barley, so choose gluten-free if needed.

zh.name: 味噌三文鱼饭碗
zh.why: 发酵味噌有益肠道，三文鱼补 Omega-3，一碗均衡。
ingredients: 味噌 1 汤匙（选无麸质）
黄瓜片、海苔丝 适量
steps: 味噌与味醂调成酱，抹在三文鱼上腌 10 分钟。
煎或烤三文鱼至熟。
糙米饭打底，摆三文鱼、毛豆、黄瓜，撒海苔丝。
zh.notes: 需要无麸质者选无麸质味噌（多数味噌含大麦）。

en.name: Turkey & Hummus Wrap
en.why: A seven-minute meal to go: protein plus fibre, far better than takeaway.
steps: Warm the wrap briefly and spread with hummus.
Layer on the turkey, lettuce, tomato and onion; roll tightly and halve.
en.notes: Gluten-free? Use lettuce cups or a corn tortilla.

zh.name: 火鸡鹰嘴豆泥卷
zh.why: 7 分钟出门餐，蛋白 + 纤维，比外卖好太多。
ingredients: 生菜、番茄片、紫洋葱 适量
steps: 卷饼微热，抹鹰嘴豆泥。
铺火鸡、生菜、番茄、洋葱，卷紧对半切。
zh.notes: 无麸质者用生菜或玉米饼代替。

en.name: Vietnamese Chicken Salad
en.why: Bright, tangy and no-cook — made with ready-cooked chicken. Especially good in summer.
steps: Mix the fish sauce and lime juice into a dressing.
Toss everything in a large bowl with the dressing.
Scatter over the peanuts just before serving.
en.notes: Nut allergy? Leave out the peanuts and use crisp fried shallots instead.

zh.name: 越式鸡肉沙拉
zh.why: 酸辣清爽、免烹，用现成烤鸡就能做，夏天尤其合适。
steps: 鱼露、青柠汁调成汁。
所有食材放大碗，淋汁拌匀。
上桌前撒花生碎。
zh.notes: 坚果过敏者去掉花生，改用烤葱头。

en.name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
en.why: A plant-powered bowl with complete protein, healthy fats and fibre.
steps: Cook quinoa in 1:2 water for 15 minutes; roast sweet potato cubes at 200°C for 20 min.
Build bowls: quinoa, chickpeas, sweet potato, spinach.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water; drizzle and top with seeds.
en.notes: Roast a big batch of sweet potato — keeps 5 days for easy bowls.

zh.name: 藜麦佛碗
zh.why: 植物全餐，完整蛋白 + 好脂肪 + 纤维齐了。
ingredients: 芝麻酱 2 汤匙 + 柠檬汁
steps: 藜麦 1:2 水煮 15 分钟；红薯块 200°C 烤 20 分钟。
装碗：藜麦、鹰嘴豆、红薯、菠菜。
芝麻酱加柠檬与水搅稀，淋碗上撒南瓜籽。
zh.notes: 红薯一次烤一大盘，可存 5 天随取随用。

en.name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Peppers
en.why: Crunchy bell pepper replaces bread — pure protein and produce.
steps: Halve and deseed the peppers.
Mix tuna, mashed avocado, onion, lemon, salt and pepper.
Spoon into pepper halves.
en.notes: Great for a packed lunch — no bread to get soggy.

zh.name: 金枪鱼沙拉酿彩椒
zh.why: 用彩椒代替面包，纯蛋白 + 蔬菜。
steps: 彩椒对半切去籽。
金枪鱼、牛油果、洋葱、柠檬、盐和胡椒拌匀。
舀入彩椒中。
zh.notes: 带饭很合适——没有面包会变软。

en.name: Lentil Tabbouleh
en.why: Parsley and lentils bring fibre, iron and plant protein — a fresh, batch-friendly salad.
ingredients: Bulgur 1/2 cup (cooked) — or quinoa for GF
steps: Cook lentils and bulgur separately until tender; cool.
Mix with chopped herbs, tomatoes.
Dress with lemon and olive oil; season.
en.notes: Use quinoa instead of bulgur for a gluten-free version.

zh.name: 扁豆塔布勒沙拉
zh.why: 欧芹和扁豆提供纤维、铁与植物蛋白，清爽可批量。
ingredients: 布格麦 1/2 杯（煮熟）—无麸质用藜麦
柠檬 1 个、橄榄油 3 汤匙
steps: 扁豆与布格麦分别煮熟放凉。
与欧芹、薄荷、番茄混合。
加柠檬汁与橄榄油，调味即可。
zh.notes: 无麸质用藜麦代替布格麦。

en.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
en.why: A fresh bowl with sashimi-grade salmon — high protein and omega-3s in one lunch.
steps: Divide the rice between two bowls.
Arrange the salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado on top.
Drizzle with tamari and sesame oil.
en.notes: Use leftover cooked salmon if you prefer it cooked.

zh.name: 三文鱼波奇碗
zh.why: 刺身级三文鱼波奇碗，一份午餐高蛋白加 Omega-3。
steps: 糙米饭分入两个碗。
摆上三文鱼、毛豆、黄瓜与牛油果。
淋生抽与芝麻油。
zh.notes: 不喜欢生鱼可用熟三文鱼。

en.name: Plain Congee
en.why: A soft rice porridge that is the classic Chinese gut-soothing comfort food.
steps: Rinse rice, add to a pot with water.
Bring to a boil, reduce to low and cook 30–40 min, stirring to prevent sticking.
Season lightly with salt; serve plain or with pickles, eggs or shredded chicken.
en.notes: Leftover rice + less water shortens the cook time.

zh.name: 白米粥
zh.why: 中式养胃安神粥，米香软糯易吸收。
steps: 米洗净入锅加水。
煮开转小火 30–40 分钟，搅拌防粘。
少许盐调味，单吃或配咸菜、蛋、鸡丝。
zh.notes: 用剩饭、少加水可缩短时间。

en.name: Plain Greek Yogurt
en.why: Strained yogurt delivers probiotics and concentrated protein, no added sugar.
ingredients: (Optional) a drizzle of honey or berries
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Add a light topping if desired.
en.notes: Choose 2% or whole milk for satiety; 0% if watching fat.

zh.name: 原味希腊酸奶
zh.why: 滤乳清后蛋白浓缩，含益生菌，无加糖。
steps: 酸奶盛碗。
按需点缀。
zh.notes: 选 2% 或全脂更饱腹；控脂选 0%。

en.name: Millet Porridge
en.why: A gentle, easily digested grain porridge that is naturally gluten-free.
steps: Rinse millet, toast in a dry pot 1 min until fragrant.
Add water and salt, bring to a boil then simmer 20 min, stirring now and then.
Spoon into bowls; top with sweet or savoury favourites.
en.notes: For a thinner congee-style porridge, add more water.

zh.name: 小米粥
zh.why: 小米易消化、无麸质，温和养胃的早餐粥。
steps: 小米洗净，干锅小火炒 1 分钟至出香。
加水与盐煮开，转小火 20 分钟，不时搅拌。
盛碗，甜咸自选点缀。
zh.notes: 想更稀可多加水，像粥一样。

en.name: Sourdough Toast with Butter
en.why: Fermented sourdough is gentler on digestion; butter keeps you full.
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden.
Spread with butter, sprinkle with flaky salt.
en.notes: Add a soft-boiled egg or jam to make it a fuller meal.

zh.name: 酸种面包黄油吐司
zh.why: 酸种发酵更易消化，黄油带来饱腹感。
steps: 面包烤至金黄酥脆。
抹黄油，撒海盐片。
zh.notes: 可加水煮蛋或果酱变成更完整的一餐。

en.name: Chinese Tea Eggs
en.why: A savoury, protein-rich snack born from reusing steeped tea and spices.
ingredients: Black tea leaves 2 tbsp (or 2 tea bags)
Star anise 2, cinnamon 1 stick, sugar 1 tsp
steps: Boil eggs 7 min, then cool and gently crack the shells all over without peeling.
Simmer tea, soy, spices and water for 5 min.
Add cracked eggs, simmer 15 min, then soak at least 1 hr (or overnight) for a marbled look.
Peel and serve warm or chilled.
en.notes: The longer they soak, the deeper the flavour and colour.

zh.name: 茶叶蛋
zh.why: 用茶叶与香料再煮一次，蛋白滑嫩入味，高蛋白小食。
ingredients: 红茶 2 汤匙（或茶包 2 个）
八角 2 个、桂皮 1 段、糖 1 茶匙
steps: 鸡蛋煮 7 分钟，捞出轻轻敲裂蛋壳（不剥）。
茶、生抽、香料与水小火煮 5 分钟。
放入裂壳蛋煮 15 分钟，浸泡 1 小时以上（或过夜）呈大理石纹。
剥壳温食或冷食。
zh.notes: 泡得越久，颜色与味道越深。

en.name: Almond Flour Pancakes
en.why: Gluten-free and higher in protein than regular pancakes — fluffy and family-friendly.
steps: Whisk almond flour, eggs, almond milk, baking powder and vanilla into a batter.
Cook spoonfuls in a hot pan with coconut oil until golden on both sides.
Serve with berries or a drizzle of maple syrup.
en.notes: Keep the pancakes small — they flip more easily.

zh.name: 杏仁粉松饼
zh.why: 无麸质、比普通松饼高蛋白，松软适合全家。
steps: 杏仁粉、鸡蛋、杏仁奶、泡打粉与香草精打成糊。
热锅刷椰子油，舀入面糊煎至两面金黄。
配莓果或少量枫糖。
zh.notes: 松饼做小一点更容易翻面。

en.name: Protein Overnight Oats
en.why: Mix the night before for a grab-and-go breakfast with extra protein from Greek yogurt.
steps: Stir oats, yogurt, milk and chia together in a jar.
Cover and chill overnight.
Top with berries before eating.
en.notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge — make two or three jars at once.

zh.name: 高蛋白隔夜燕麦
zh.why: 前一晚拌好，早上直接吃，希腊酸奶额外加蛋白。
steps: 燕麦、酸奶、奶与奇亚籽在罐中搅匀。
盖好冷藏过夜。
吃前铺莓果。
zh.notes: 冷藏可存 3 天——一次做两三罐。

en.name: Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
en.why: A balanced savoury breakfast — complex carbs, fibre and protein in one pan.
steps: Sauté the sweet potato, onion and pepper in oil until tender (~12 min).
Make 4 wells in the hash and crack an egg into each; cover and cook until set.
Season and serve.
en.notes: Use white potato for higher carb, or cauliflower rice for low carb.

zh.name: 红薯鸡蛋锅
zh.why: 咸香早餐一锅出，复合碳水、纤维与蛋白都齐了。
ingredients: 洋葱半个、彩椒半个（切丁）
红椒粉、海盐、黑胡椒 适量
steps: 油炒红薯、洋葱、彩椒至软（约 12 分钟）。
挖 4 个坑各打入一个蛋，盖盖焖至凝固。
调味即可。
zh.notes: 想低碳可换花菜米；想高碳可换普通土豆。

en.name: Oatmeal
en.why: Soluble fibre from oats supports gut health; berries add antioxidants.
steps: Cook the oats in water or milk according to the package.
Stir in flax and cinnamon; top with a touch of maple.
en.notes: Use steel-cut oats for even more fibre (just allow 20 min).

zh.name: 燕麦粥
zh.why: 燕麦的可溶性纤维助肠道，蓝莓补抗氧化物。
steps: 燕麦加水或奶按包装说明煮熟。
拌入亚麻籽与肉桂，淋少量枫糖。
zh.notes: 用钢切燕麦纤维更高（需 20 分钟）。

en.name: Cottage Cheese Berry Bowl
en.why: Cottage cheese is protein-dense and satisfying — a no-cook 3-minute bowl.
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with berries, chia and cinnamon.
en.notes: Switch berries for kiwi or melon for variety.

zh.name: 茅屋奶酪莓果碗
zh.why: 茅屋奶酪高蛋白饱腹，3 分钟免烹早餐。
steps: 茅屋奶酪盛入碗中。
加莓果、奇亚籽与肉桂粉即可。
zh.notes: 莓果可换猕猴桃或蜜瓜。

en.name: Turmeric Veggie Scramble
en.why: Turmeric is anti-inflammatory; peppers and onions add antioxidants.
ingredients: Sea salt, black pepper to taste
steps: Heat the oil and soften the onion and pepper.
Stir in the turmeric, then add the eggs and scramble until just set.
en.notes: Pair turmeric with black pepper for better absorption. Egg-sensitive? Use scrambled tofu.

zh.name: 姜黄蔬菜炒蛋
zh.why: 姜黄有助抗炎，搭配彩椒洋葱补充抗氧化物质。
ingredients: 彩椒、洋葱 各 1/4 个（切丁）
steps: 热锅下油，炒软洋葱与彩椒。
加姜黄粉略炒，倒入蛋液翻炒至凝固即可。
zh.notes: 姜黄配黑胡椒吸收更好；对蛋敏感者可换炒豆腐。

en.name: Overnight Chia Pudding
en.why: No-cook and make-ahead; rich in soluble fibre for a zero-effort breakfast.
ingredients: Fresh berries / coconut flakes to top
steps: Stir the chia into the milk; after 10 minutes stir again to break up clumps.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Top with berries and coconut flakes before serving.
en.notes: Make 3–4 jars at once — keeps 4 days in the fridge. A classic batch-cook item.

zh.name: 隔夜奇亚籽布丁
zh.why: 免烹、可一次做几份冷藏，可溶性纤维丰富，早餐零负担。
ingredients: 新鲜莓果 / 椰蓉 点缀
steps: 奇亚籽与奶液搅匀，静置 10 分钟后再搅一次防止结块。
盖好冷藏至少 4 小时或过夜。
食用前加莓果与椰蓉。
zh.notes: 一次做 3–4 罐，冷藏可存 4 天，是 batch-cook 的典型。

en.name: Spinach & Mushroom Omelette
en.why: Low-carb and high-protein, with soluble fibre and minerals from spinach and mushrooms.
ingredients: Sea salt, black pepper to taste
steps: Beat and season the eggs. Heat the oil and sauté the mushrooms until golden.
Add spinach and cook until just wilted; pour in the eggs and spread evenly.
Cook on low until set, then fold and serve.
en.notes: Egg-sensitive? Swap for a firm tofu scramble.

zh.name: 菠菜蘑菇欧姆蛋
zh.why: 低碳高蛋白，菠菜与蘑菇提供可溶性纤维与矿物质，血糖友好。
steps: 鸡蛋打散调味；热锅下橄榄油，炒香蘑菇至微黄。
加菠菜炒至刚软，倒入蛋液铺平。
小火煎至凝固，对折出锅。
zh.notes: 对蛋敏感者换豆腐炒（firm tofu scramble）。

en.name: Apple Slices & Almond Butter
en.why: Fibre plus healthy fat — a golden combination that slows the blood-sugar rise.
steps: Slice the apple, dip in the almond butter and dust with cinnamon.
en.notes: Nut allergy? Use sunflower seed butter.

zh.name: 苹果片配杏仁酱
zh.why: 纤维 + 好脂肪的黄金组合，延缓血糖上升，解馋又稳。
steps: 苹果切片，蘸杏仁酱，撒肉桂粉。
zh.notes: 坚果过敏者可换葵花籽酱。

en.name: Toasted Walnuts
en.why: Omega-3-rich crunch; toasting deepens flavour.
steps: Toast walnuts in a dry pan 5 min over medium heat, stirring.
Sprinkle with salt; cool before serving.
en.notes: Cool fully to keep them crisp.

zh.name: 烤核桃
zh.why: 富含Omega-3，烘烤更香。
steps: 干锅中火烘 5 分钟搅拌。
撒盐，晾凉再吃。
zh.notes: 完全晾凉才脆。

en.name: Nut Butter Stuffed Dates
en.why: A naturally sweet, energy-boosting snack with healthy fats.
steps: Pit the dates.
Spoon nut butter into each; sprinkle with salt.
en.notes: Chill 10 min so the butter firms up.

zh.name: 坚果酱夹心椰枣
zh.why: 天然甜、能量足，含好脂肪。
ingredients: 杏仁酱或花生酱 4 汤匙
steps: 枣去核。
填入坚果酱，撒盐。
zh.notes: 冷藏 10 分钟更凝实。

en.name: Smashed Cucumber Salad
en.why: A refreshing, crunchy cold side with a garlicky soy dressing.
ingredients: Soy 1 tbsp, vinegar 1 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tsp
steps: Smash cucumbers with a rolling pin; tear into chunks.
Toss with minced garlic, soy, vinegar, sesame oil and chilli.
Chill 5 min before serving.
en.notes: Smashing helps the dressing soak in.

zh.name: 凉拌拍黄瓜
zh.why: 脆爽凉菜，蒜香酱汁。
ingredients: 生抽 1 汤匙、醋 1 汤匙、香油 1 茶匙
steps: 擀面杖拍碎黄瓜撕块。
拌蒜蓉、生抽、醋、香油、辣椒。
冷藏 5 分钟。
zh.notes: 拍碎更入味。

en.name: Grapes with Cheddar
en.why: A sweet-salty, no-prep snack with protein and fruit.
steps: Cube the cheese; plate with grapes.
en.notes: Any firm cheese works — try manchego or gouda.

zh.name: 葡萄配车打奶酪
zh.why: 咸甜免备，蛋白配水果。
ingredients: 陈年车打奶酪 40g 切丁
steps: 奶酪切丁，与葡萄同盘。
zh.notes: 可用曼彻格或高达。

en.name: Chicken Bone Broth
en.why: Long-simmered broth rich in collagen and minerals; sips like a warm tonic.
steps: Roast bones 30 min for deeper flavour.
Simmer all with water 8–12 hr, skimming foam.
Strain; season with salt.
en.notes: Freeze in jars; sip warm or use as a cooking base.

zh.name: 鸡骨汤
zh.why: 久熬出胶原矿物质，暖身如饮汤。
steps: 骨头烤 30 分钟更香。
加水小火 8–12 小时撇沫。
过滤，盐调味。
zh.notes: 分装冷冻，可饮可作汤底。

en.name: Beef Bone Broth
en.why: Rich, gelatinous broth from marrow bones — deeply nourishing.
steps: Roast bones 40 min at 200°C.
Simmer with veg and water 12–18 hr.
Strain; season with salt.
en.notes: The longer the simmer, the more collagen extracted.

zh.name: 牛骨汤
zh.why: 骨髓骨熬出胶质，滋补。
steps: 骨头 200°C 烤 40 分钟。
加菜与水小火 12–18 小时。
过滤，盐调味。
zh.notes: 越久胶原越多。

en.name: Pork Bone Broth
en.why: A milky-white, collagen-rich broth — the base of tonkotsu and many soups.
steps: Blanch bones 5 min; rinse well.
Simmer with ginger, onion and water 8–10 hr, keeping it at a gentle boil for a milky colour.
Strain; season with salt.
en.notes: A rolling boil gives the signature milky white colour.

zh.name: 猪骨汤
zh.why: 奶白胶原汤，豚骨汤底。
steps: 骨焯水 5 分钟洗净。
加姜葱水微滚 8–10 小时成奶白。
过滤，盐调味。
zh.notes: 保持微滚才出奶白。

en.name: Fish Meat Stock
en.why: A short-simmered, meaty fish stock — lighter than bone broth, GAPS-friendly.
steps: Cover bones with cold water; bring just to a simmer.
Skim foam; add veg and wine.
Simmer 1–2 hr gently; strain.
en.notes: Meat stock cooks 1–2 hr for fish; longer gives a stronger bone broth.

zh.name: 鱼肉高汤
zh.why: 短炖肉鱼汤，比骨汤轻，GAPS 友好。
steps: 骨加冷水刚煮开。
撇沫，加菜与酒。
小火 1–2 小时，过滤。
zh.notes: 鱼肉肉汤炖 1–2 小时；更久则为骨汤。

en.name: Chicken Meat Stock
en.why: Meaty chicken joints simmered 2–4 hr — a GAPS-style restorative stock.
steps: Cover meaty joints with water and vinegar.
Simmer 2–4 hr, skimming foam.
Strain; season with salt.
en.notes: Meat stock is shorter than bone broth; use within 5 days or freeze.

zh.name: 鸡肉高汤
zh.why: 带肉鸡件炖 2–4 小时，GAPS 修护汤。
steps: 带肉件加水醋。
小火 2–4 小时撇沫。
过滤，盐调味。
zh.notes: 肉汤比骨汤时间短；5 天内食完或冷冻。

en.name: Beef Meat Stock
en.why: Meaty beef joints simmered 4–8 hr for a deeply restorative GAPS stock.
ingredients: Beef shank / oxtail / marrow bones with meat 700g
steps: Brown meaty bones in a hot pan.
Cover with water and vinegar; simmer 4–8 hr, skimming.
Strain; season with salt.
en.notes: Use the tender meat for soup; keep the stock for sipping or cooking.

zh.name: 牛肉高汤
zh.why: 带肉牛件炖 4–8 小时，GAPS 修护汤。
steps: 带肉骨热锅煎香。
加水醋小火 4–8 小时撇沫。
过滤，盐调味。
zh.notes: 肉可入汤，汤可饮可煮。

en.name: Crackers with Cheese
en.why: A simple, satisfying snack with carbs, fat and protein for steady energy.
steps: Arrange cheese slices on crackers. Serve.
en.notes: Add a slice of apple or cherry tomatoes for extra fibre.

zh.name: 芝士梳打饼
zh.why: 简单的碳水加蛋白质加脂肪组合，稳能量的快手小食。
steps: 芝士片放饼上即可。
zh.notes: 可加苹果片或小番茄增加纤维。

en.name: Canned Sardines
en.why: Omega-3-rich fish with bones for calcium — one of nature’s most nutrient-dense snacks.
ingredients: Canned sardines in olive oil 1 tin (≈ 92g)
Lemon juice or hot sauce to taste
steps: Open tin, drain excess oil. Squeeze lemon or add hot sauce. Eat from the tin or plate.
en.notes: Bones are soft and edible — they provide calcium.

zh.name: 沙丁鱼罐头
zh.why: 富含 Omega-3 与钙质（骨可食），天然高营养小食。
ingredients: 橄榄油沙丁鱼罐头 1 罐（约 92g）
steps: 开罐沥油，挤柠檬汁或加辣酱即可。
zh.notes: 鱼骨软可食，是天然钙源。

en.name: Baked Potato Wedges
en.why: A healthier alternative to fried chips — crispy outside, fluffy inside, with the skin on for fibre.
ingredients: Paprika ½ tsp, garlic powder ½ tsp, salt ½ tsp
steps: Preheat oven 220 °C / 425 °F. Cut each potato into 6–8 wedges (leave skin on).
Toss wedges with oil and spices in a bowl.
Arrange on a lined baking tray, cut-side up.
Bake 25–30 min until golden and crisp. Serve hot.
en.notes: Soak cut wedges in cold water 15 min before baking for extra crispiness.

zh.name: 烤薯角
zh.why: 比炸薯条更健康——外脆内软，带皮保纤维。
ingredients: 红椒粉 ½ 茶匙、蒜粉 ½ 茶匙、盐 ½ 茶匙
steps: 预热烤箱 220°C。每个土豆切 6–8 块（带皮）。
薯角与油和调料在碗中拌匀。
排列在铺纸烤盘上，切面朝上。
烤 25–30 分钟至金黄酥脆，趁热享用。
zh.notes: 切好的薯角先冷水泡 15 分钟会更脆。

en.name: High-Protein Fried Rice
en.why: More eggs, more veggies, less rice — a protein-forward twist on a takeaway classic.
ingredients: Light soy sauce 1 tbsp, sesame oil 1 tsp
steps: Heat a wok or large pan with a little oil; scramble the eggs quickly, then set aside.
Stir-fry the sliced sausage until lightly caramelised; add garlic and frozen veg.
Add the cold rice, breaking up clumps; toss over high heat 2–3 min.
Return eggs, drizzle soy and sesame oil; toss to combine.
Garnish with spring onion and serve.
en.notes: Using cold, day-old rice gives the best texture. Add more eggs for extra protein.

zh.name: 高蛋白蛋炒饭
zh.why: 蛋多菜多饭少，蛋白质满满的改良炒饭。
ingredients: 生抽 1 汤匙、麻油 1 茶匙
steps: 热锅少油，鸡蛋快速炒散，盛出备用。
腊肠片煎至微焦，加蒜末和杂菜翻炒。
加入冷饭打散，大火翻炒 2–3 分钟。
放回鸡蛋，淋生抽和麻油翻匀。
撒葱花出锅。
zh.notes: 用隔夜冷饭口感最佳，多加蛋更营养。

en.name: White Rice
en.why: A fluffy, neutral base that pairs with any stir-fry, stew or curry.
steps: Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Combine rice and water in a pot; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to lowest heat and cook 15 min.
Rest off heat 5 min, then fluff with a fork.
en.notes: Ratio 1 : 1.5 (rice : water). For rice cooker, use the same ratio.

zh.name: 白米饭
zh.why: 蓬松中性的主食基底，百搭炒菜炖菜。
ingredients: 白米（茉莉或圆粒）1 杯
steps: 淘米至水清。
米水入锅大火煮开。
盖盖转小火煮 15 分钟。
离火焖 5 分钟，松饭。
zh.notes: 米水比 1 : 1.5。电饭锅同比例。

en.name: Brown Rice
en.why: Whole-grain rice with more fibre and minerals than white — gut-friendly and filling.
steps: Rinse brown rice well.
Combine rice and water in a pot; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to lowest heat and cook 35 min.
Rest off heat 10 min, then fluff.
en.notes: Ratio 1 : 2 (rice : water). Soaking 30 min beforehand shortens cooking time.

zh.name: 糙米饭
zh.why: 全谷米，纤维与矿物质高于白米，养胃饱腹。
steps: 糙米充分淘洗。
米水入锅大火煮开。
盖盖转小火煮 35 分钟。
离火焖 10 分钟，松饭。
zh.notes: 米水比 1 : 2。提前浸泡 30 分钟可缩短煮制时间。

en.name: Quinoa
en.why: A complete-protein grain with all nine essential amino acids — a nutritious rice alternative.
steps: Rinse quinoa thoroughly under cold water to remove bitterness.
Combine with water in a pot; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 min until water is absorbed.
Rest off heat 5 min, then fluff with a fork.
en.notes: Ratio 1 : 2 (quinoa : water). Cooked quinoa keeps 5 days in the fridge.

zh.name: 藜麦饭
zh.why: 含全部九种必需氨基酸的完全蛋白谷物，米饭替代佳品。
steps: 藜麦充分冷水冲洗去苦味。
加水入锅大火煮开。
盖盖小火煮 15 分钟至水收干。
离火焖 5 分钟，松饭。
zh.notes: 藜麦水比 1 : 2。煮熟冷藏可放 5 天。

en.name: Rice Noodles
en.why: A light, gluten-free noodle base that absorbs the flavour of any sauce or broth.
steps: Place noodles in a heatproof bowl.
Pour boiling water to cover; let soak 3–5 min until tender.
Drain and rinse briefly with warm water. Serve with your favourite sauce or stir-fry.
en.notes: Soaking time varies by thickness — check the package instructions.

zh.name: 米粉
zh.why: 无麸质清淡主食，吸附酱汁与汤底。
steps: 米粉放入耐热碗。
倒入沸水浸泡 3–5 分钟至软。
沥水，温水略冲，可拌酱或炒制。
zh.notes: 浸泡时间因粗细而异，参考包装说明。

en.name: Plain Pasta
en.why: A comforting carb base — dress simply with olive oil and salt, or build any sauce on top.
steps: Bring salted water to a rolling boil.
Add pasta, stir to prevent sticking; cook per package (usually 8–11 min).
Drain, reserving ½ cup pasta water. Toss with olive oil to prevent clumping.
en.notes: 80g dry pasta per serving = 1.5-2 cups of cooked pasta

zh.name: 意面
zh.why: 舒适的碳水基底，可简单橄榄油盐拌，或搭配任意酱料。
steps: 盐水大火烧开。
放入意面搅拌防粘，按包装时间煮（一般 8–11 分钟）。
沥水，留半杯面汤。拌橄榄油防结块。
zh.notes: 比包装时间提前 1 分钟试口感，弹牙为佳。

en.name: Seared Tuna
en.why: A restaurant-quality dish at home — crisp crust, rare centre, packed with lean protein.
ingredients: Sesame oil 1 tsp, soy sauce 1 tsp
Black and white sesame seeds 2 tbsp
Wasabi or pickled ginger to serve
steps: Coat tuna with soy and sesame oil; press sesame seeds onto all sides.
Sear in a smoking-hot pan 30–45 seconds per side (keep centre rare).
Rest 2 min, then slice across the grain.
Serve with wasabi or pickled ginger.
en.notes: Use sashimi-grade tuna for safe raw centre. Freeze for 15 min before searing for easier slicing.

zh.name: 香煎金枪鱼
zh.why: 家中可做的餐厅级料理——外脆内嫩，瘦蛋白满满。
ingredients: 麻油 1 茶匙、生抽 1 茶匙
steps: 鱼扒抹酱油麻油，各面压芝麻。
热锅冒烟，每面煎 30–45 秒（中心保持生）。
静置 2 分钟，逆纹切片。
配芥末或腌姜食用。
zh.notes: 须用刺身级金枪鱼，中心可安全生食。煎前冷冻 15 分钟更易切片。

en.name: Tuna Salad
en.why: No-cook, high-protein lunch that travels well — just mix and eat.
ingredients: Canned tuna in water 1 tin (≈ 140g), drained
steps: Flake tuna into a bowl. Add mayo, celery, onion, salt and pepper. Mix well.
Serve on lettuce leaves or with crackers.
en.notes: Swap mayo for Greek yogurt for a lighter version.

zh.name: 简易金枪鱼沙拉
zh.why: 免煮高蛋白午餐，混合即食，适合外带。
ingredients: 水浸金枪鱼罐头 1 罐（约 140g），沥干
steps: 金枪鱼放入碗中，加蛋黄酱、芹菜、洋葱、盐和胡椒拌匀。
配生菜叶或梳打饼食用。
zh.notes: 用希腊酸奶代替蛋黄酱可减脂。

en.name: Cheddar Cheese
en.why: A protein-rich, zero-prep snack that curbs hunger fast.
steps: Slice and serve.
en.notes: 40g cheese cubes = 6 dice

zh.name: 车打芝士片
zh.why: 高蛋白零准备小食，快速止饿。
steps: 切片即食。
zh.notes: 可配几粒杏仁增加口感和健康脂肪。

en.name: Plain Crackers
en.why: A quick carb top-up for between-meal energy dips.
steps: Open and eat.
en.notes: Top with cheese or nut butter for added protein.

zh.name: 梳打饼
zh.why: 快速补充碳水，缓解餐间能量下降。
steps: 拆包即食。
zh.notes: 可加芝士或坚果酱增加蛋白质。

en.name: Half Avocado
en.why: Creamy, fibre-rich and loaded with heart-healthy monounsaturated fats.
steps: Halve avocado, remove pit, season the cavity. Scoop and eat with a spoon.
en.notes: Sprinkle with Everything Bagel seasoning for extra flavour.

zh.name: 半个牛油果
zh.why: 口感细腻，富含纤维和有益心脏的单不饱和脂肪。
steps: 牛油果对半切开去核，撒上调料，用勺子挖食。
zh.notes: 撒点综合调味料更提味。

en.name: Mixed Berries
en.why: Antioxidant-packed, low-GI fruit that satisfies a sweet craving without a sugar crash.
ingredients: Mixed berries 1 cup (blueberries, raspberries, strawberries) ~150 g
steps: Wash and serve in a bowl.
en.notes: Add a dollop of Greek yogurt for extra protein.

zh.name: 混合莓果
zh.why: 富含抗氧化物、低升糖指数水果，满足甜食欲望又不致血糖飙升。
ingredients: 混合莓果 1 杯（蓝莓、覆盆子、草莓）约 150g
steps: 洗净盛碗即食。
zh.notes: 加一勺希腊酸奶增加蛋白质。

en.name: Hummus with Crackers
en.why: Plant protein and fibre from chickpeas paired with satisfying crunch.
steps: Scoop hummus onto a plate, arrange crackers alongside. Dip and enjoy.
en.notes: Add cucumber or carrot sticks for extra veg. Use gluten-free crackers if needed.

zh.name: 鹰嘴豆泥配梳打饼
zh.why: 鹰嘴豆提供植物蛋白和纤维，搭配酥脆饼干。
steps: 鹰嘴豆泥盛碟，搭配饼干蘸食。
zh.notes: 可加黄瓜或胡萝卜条增加蔬菜。需要无麸质可换无麸饼干。

en.name: Granola
en.why: A crunchy, energy-dense handful of oats, nuts and seeds — great pre-workout.
steps: Portion into a small bowl. Eat dry or with a splash of milk.
en.notes: Check the label — many store-bought granolas are high in added sugar.

zh.name: 格兰诺拉麦片
zh.why: 燕麦、坚果和种子的酥脆能量组合——适合运动前补充。
ingredients: 格兰诺拉麦片 半杯（约 60g）
steps: 盛入小碗干食或加少许牛奶。
zh.notes: 注意标签——许多市售格兰诺拉含糖量较高。

en.name: Macadamia Nuts
en.why: The highest-fat, lowest-carb nut — buttery and rich, perfect for keto snacking.
steps: Portion and enjoy.
en.notes: Macadamias are calorie-dense — stick to a small handful.

zh.name: 夏威夷果
zh.why: 脂肪最高、碳水最低的坚果——口感醇厚，适合生酮零食。
steps: 取量即食。
zh.notes: 夏威夷果热量密度高，请控制在手心一把。

en.name: 2% Milk
en.why: Reduced-fat milk with a balance of protein, calcium and carbs for bone health.
steps: Pour into a glass. Drink cold or warm.
en.notes: Whole milk (3.25%) has more fat; skim milk has less. 2% is the sweet spot for many.

zh.name: 2% 牛奶
zh.why: 减脂牛奶——蛋白质、钙和碳水平衡，有益骨骼健康。
steps: 倒入杯中，冷饮或加热均可。
zh.notes: 全脂牛奶（3.25%）脂肪更高；脱脂牛奶脂肪更少。2% 是多数人的理想选择。

en.name: Calcium-Fortified Soy Milk
en.why: A dairy-free, high-calcium beverage — ideal for lactose-intolerant or plant-based diets.
steps: Pour into a glass. Drink cold or warm.
en.notes: Shake well before pouring. Choose unsweetened for lowest carbs.

zh.name: 高钙豆浆
zh.why: 无乳制品的高钙饮品——适合乳糖不耐受或植物性饮食。
steps: 倒入杯中，冷饮或加热均可。
zh.notes: 倒前摇匀。选无糖版碳水最低。

en.name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
en.why: An Asian one-pan dinner with plenty of vegetables and enough protein.
steps: Heat the sesame oil and cook the chicken until it changes colour; set aside.
Sauté the garlic and ginger, then stir-fry the bok choy.
Return the chicken, add the tamari and vinegar, and toss to finish.
en.notes: Serve with brown rice for moderate carb, or cauliflower rice for low carb.

zh.name: 小白菜炒鸡片
zh.why: 一锅到底的亚洲快手菜，蔬菜量足、蛋白够。
ingredients: 蒜末、姜末 各 1 茶匙
steps: 热锅下麻油，鸡肉炒至变色盛出。
炒香蒜姜，下小白菜快炒。
回锅鸡肉，淋生抽与米醋翻匀出锅。
zh.notes: 配糙米饭即中碳，配花菜饭即低碳。

en.name: Garlic Butter Salmon
en.why: A 15-minute low-carb dinner with omega-3s and healthy fats.
ingredients: Asparagus or green beans to serve
steps: Pan-sear the salmon skin-down 4 minutes; flip and cook 3 more.
Add butter and garlic; baste the fish for 1 minute.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley; serve with greens.
en.notes: Use ghee for a dairy-light version.

zh.name: 蒜香黄油三文鱼
zh.why: 15 分钟低碳晚餐，Omega-3 与好脂肪齐了。
ingredients: 芦笋或四季豆 适量
steps: 三文鱼皮朝下煎 4 分钟，翻面再煎 3 分钟。
加黄油与蒜末，浇汁 1 分钟。
淋柠檬汁撒欧芹，配青菜。
zh.notes: 用澄清黄油（ghee）更清淡。

en.name: Edamame with Sea Salt
en.why: Plant protein and fibre — and shelling them slows the pace of eating.
steps: Boil the edamame 4–5 minutes, drain and sprinkle with salt.
en.notes: Buy them in the pod — it feels more like a snack.

zh.name: 海盐毛豆
zh.why: 植物蛋白 + 纤维，剥壳过程还能放慢进食速度。
steps: 毛豆煮 4–5 分钟，沥干撒盐即可。
zh.notes: 买带壳的更有"吃零食"的仪式感。

en.name: Celery & Peanut Butter
en.why: A classic low-carb snack — fibre from celery, healthy fat from peanut butter.
steps: Cut the celery into sticks; spread with peanut butter.
en.notes: Use sunflower seed butter for nut-free; almond butter also works.

zh.name: 芹菜配花生酱
zh.why: 经典低碳零食，芹菜纤维 + 花生酱好脂肪。
steps: 芹菜切条，抹花生酱即可。
zh.notes: 无坚果者用葵花籽酱；杏仁酱也行。

en.name: Egg Muffin Cups
en.why: Bake a batch on Sunday and grab two each morning — a portable, high-protein breakfast.
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C; grease a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, vegetables, cheese and seasoning; divide into the tin.
Bake 18 minutes until set; cool and store in the fridge.
en.notes: Freeze extras and reheat in the microwave for 40 seconds.

zh.name: 鸡蛋麦芬杯
zh.why: 周日烤一批，每天早上拿两个，便携高蛋白早餐。
steps: 烤箱 180°C 预热，麦芬模刷油。
鸡蛋与蔬菜、奶酪、调味打匀，分装入模。
烤 18 分钟至凝固，冷却后冷藏保存。
zh.notes: 多余的可冷冻，微波加热 40 秒。

en.name: Almond Energy Balls
en.why: No-bake, batch-friendly and portable — dates and almonds provide sustained energy.
steps: Blend the almonds and dates in a food processor until sticky.
Add cocoa, chia and coconut oil; pulse until combined.
Roll into 6 balls; chill 30 minutes to set.
en.notes: Store in the fridge for up to two weeks.

zh.name: 杏仁能量球
zh.why: 免烤可批量便携，椰枣与杏仁持续供能。
steps: 杏仁与椰枣用料理机打至粘稠。
加可可粉、奇亚籽与椰子油，搅打均匀。
搓成 6 个球，冷藏 30 分钟定型。
zh.notes: 冷藏可存两周。

en.name: Freezer Breakfast Burrito
en.why: Make a batch on Sunday; grab one on a busy weekday for a protein-rich breakfast.
steps: Scramble the eggs with the beans, pepper, spices and cheese.
Spoon onto tortillas and roll up tightly.
Wrap each in foil and freeze; reheat from frozen in a pan or microwave.
en.notes: Use gluten-free tortillas if needed. ~3 minutes to reheat.

zh.name: 冷冻早餐卷饼
zh.why: 周日做一批冷冻，工作日早上直接热一个，蛋白够。
ingredients: 孜然、红椒粉、海盐 适量
steps: 鸡蛋与黑豆、彩椒、香料、奶酪一起炒散。
舀到饼上卷紧。
每条用锡纸包好冷冻，吃时锅里或微波炉加热。
zh.notes: 无麸质者用无麸质卷饼；加热约 3 分钟。

en.name: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
en.why: Low-carb and crunchy — lettuce replaces the wrap, so it satisfies without spiking blood sugar.
steps: Heat the sesame oil; sauté the garlic and ginger, then add the chicken and break it up.
Add the mushrooms and tamari; cook until the liquid reduces.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with scallions.
en.notes: Soy-free? Use coconut aminos instead of tamari.

zh.name: 亚洲鸡肉生菜包
zh.why: 低碳、爽脆，用生菜代替饼皮，饱腹又不升糖。
ingredients: 蒜末、姜末 各 1 茶匙
steps: 热锅下麻油，炒香蒜姜，加鸡肉末炒散。
加香菇丁与生抽炒至收汁。
盛入洗净的生菜叶，撒葱花即可。
zh.notes: 需要无大豆者用椰子氨基（coconut aminos）代替生抽。

en.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
en.why: Classic high-protein salad — use a lighter dressing to keep it gut-friendly.
steps: Slice the chicken. Wash and chop the romaine.
Toss lettuce and tomatoes with dressing; top with chicken and parmesan.
en.notes: Use Greek yogurt dressing for a lighter version; skip croutons for low carb.

zh.name: 凯撒鸡肉沙拉
zh.why: 经典高蛋白沙拉，用清淡酱更肠道友好。
ingredients: 凯撒酱 2 汤匙（低脂版）
steps: 鸡肉切片；生菜洗净切粗段。
生菜与小番茄拌酱，铺鸡肉与帕玛森。
zh.notes: 用希腊酸奶酱更清淡；低碳者不加面包丁。

en.name: Chickpea Salad Sandwich
en.why: A plant-based tuna-salad-style sandwich — high in fibre and protein.
steps: Mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some texture.
Mix in celery, onion, mayo, lemon, salt and pepper.
Build sandwiches with lettuce and tomato.
en.notes: Use gluten-free bread; for low-carb serve in lettuce cups.

zh.name: 鹰嘴豆沙拉三明治
zh.why: 植物版金枪鱼沙拉三明治，高纤维高蛋白。
ingredients: 鹰嘴豆罐头 1 罐（压碎）
steps: 鹰嘴豆用叉子压成带颗粒的泥。
拌入芹菜、洋葱、蛋黄酱、柠檬、盐和胡椒。
配生菜番茄夹成三明治。
zh.notes: 无麸质用无麸质面包；低碳可用生菜杯。

en.name: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
en.why: All the flavour of fried rice with a fraction of the carbs — a quick Asian-style lunch.
steps: Scramble the eggs in sesame oil; set aside.
Sauté garlic, carrot and peas; add the cauliflower rice and stir-fry 4 minutes.
Return the eggs, add tamari and toss.
en.notes: Use bagged cauliflower rice to save prep time.

zh.name: 鸡蛋花菜饭
zh.why: 有炒饭味但碳水极低，亚洲风快手午餐。
steps: 芝麻油炒散鸡蛋，盛出。
炒蒜、胡萝卜、豌豆，加花菜饭炒 4 分钟。
回锅鸡蛋，加生抽翻匀。
zh.notes: 用袋装花菜米省备料时间。

en.name: Coconut Lentil Curry
en.why: A gentle, plant-based curry that freezes beautifully — coconut milk soothes the gut.
steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil; stir in the curry powder.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted; season and serve.
en.notes: Freezes well — make a double batch for easy weeknight dinners.

zh.name: 椰奶扁豆咖喱
zh.why: 温和的植物咖喱，冷冻保存好，椰奶养胃。
steps: 橄榄油炒洋葱，加咖喱粉炒香。
加扁豆、番茄与椰奶，小火炖 25 分钟。
拌入菠菜至软，调味上桌。
zh.notes: 可冷冻——做双倍量工作日晚餐随取随热。
